title: True / False Question

attributes.name: question
attributes.description: Question for users to respond to.

example_html:
<true-false-question question="HAX is game changing."><input type="checkbox" value="True" correct>
<input type="checkbox" value="False"></true-false-question>
agent_notes: the correct answer is a child <input type=checkbox value=True|False> carrying a bare `correct` attribute; the editor-only _tfanswer property is stripped on save (saveOptions.unsetAttributes).
